name: Tenant isolation
verification: Tenant library overrides/private pricing cannot be read by another tenant.

name: Base library protection
verification: Platform base records require platform-library authority to alter.

name: Approval segregation
verification: Configured approval policy prevents unauthorized self-approval where required.

name: Vendor price confidentiality
verification: Vendor quote/source metadata follows tenant and vendor-access permissions.

name: Import validation
verification: Imported files/rows are validated before commit; invalid rows cannot bypass rules.

name: AI proposal boundary
verification: AI can create proposals only; protected publication action requires authorized human.

name: Snapshot immutability
verification: Estimator library snapshots cannot be mutated after creation.

name: Audit visibility
verification: Audit access is role-scoped and does not expose restricted commercial data.

name: Unit conversion governance
verification: Only approved conversions can be used in published calculations.

name: Source attachment permissions
verification: Quote/source attachments inherit tenant/document access rules.

name: Bulk edit permissions
verification: Bulk mutation requires specific library-edit/import entitlement.

name: API filtering
verification: Search/query APIs apply tenant/base scope and field-level restrictions where configured.
